title: Single-page restaurant website for Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant (red/white theme + menu)

requirements.text: Create a responsive single-page website for the restaurant with a consistent red-and-white visual theme.

quotes: Theme: Use a red and white color scheme to match their physical menu board.

acceptanceCriteria: Page renders as a single-page layout (no required multi-page navigation)
Red/white theme is applied consistently across header, sections, and menu presentation
Layout is responsive and usable on mobile and desktop

requirements.text: Implement a header section that displays the restaurant name “Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant” and includes the alternate name “Mehfil Mandi House” (e.g., as a subtitle or secondary label). Add a prominent “Call Now” button that links to tel:6305855373.

quotes: Name: Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant (also appears to go by "Mehfil Mandi House" on the exterior board).
Header: Include the restaurant name and a 'Call Now' button linking to '6305855373'.

acceptanceCriteria: Header shows primary name exactly as “Mehfil Limra Paradise Restaurant”
Alternate name “Mehfil Mandi House” is visible in the header area
“Call Now” button uses a tel: link (tel:6305855373) and is easily clickable on mobile

requirements.text: Add a Location section that displays the address text: “Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad”.

quotes: Location Section: Display the address 'Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad'.

acceptanceCriteria: Location section is present on the page
Address text matches exactly: “Opp. Pillar No. 103, Attapur X Roads, Hyderabad”

requirements.text: Digitize the provided menu items into a clean table or grid layout with columns for Item, Single price, and Full price. Use “--” where a Single/Full price is not provided. Include placeholders for additional items not enumerated by the user (as stand-in rows/cards without specific pricing).

quotes: Please digitize the following menu items into a clean HTML table or Grid view with prices (Single / Full):
(Include placeholders for the rest of the items visible in the menu image).

acceptanceCriteria: Menu section displays at least the 9 specified items with the exact prices and “--” where indicated
Menu shows Single and Full pricing fields/columns for each listed item
Additional placeholder entries are visible to represent other items not yet digitized
Menu layout remains readable on mobile (no horizontal overflow for typical phone widths)

requirements.text: Generate and include basic restaurant branding imagery as static assets and display them on the page (e.g., logo badge and a subtle hero/banner graphic) while staying within the red/white theme.

quotes: Theme: Use a red and white color scheme to match their physical menu board.

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the UI
At least one logo-like badge image is displayed near the header
At least one banner/hero-style image is displayed in the top section or as a section header background
Images visually match a red/white palette and do not introduce unrelated colors as dominant accents

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text

Frontend must be implemented with the provided React + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui template; do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT
No external website is required or assumed for the restaurant (do not add .com links unless provided)
nonGoals: Online ordering, payments, or delivery integrations (e.g., Swiggy/Zomato)
Admin panel/CMS for editing menu content

required: Circular restaurant logo/badge in red and white with decorative border and simple text styling (mehfil-logo-badge.dim_512x512.png)
Wide hero/banner background with subtle red-and-white pattern or texture (mehfil-hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png)
